summary: Recent changes in the libwebrtc build focused on improving the build process by suppressing certain compiler warnings, specifically `-Wcomma` and `-Wtautological-type-limit-compare`. This adjustment helps streamline the development workflow by reducing unnecessary clutter in error messages, allowing developers to focus on more critical issues. While this change won’t affect the features of WebRTC, which is the technology powering video calls, it enhances the overall stability and maintainability of the code, ensuring a smoother experience for those working on or using WebRTC.
